content.title: Discovery Trail Maintenance Project
content.summary: The Discovery Trail maintenance project in Arvada is now complete, enhancing safety and accessibility for pedestrians, cyclists, and users of mobility devices. The City invested $50,000 in concrete maintenance and installed fencing to restrict access to non-motorized traffic only, ensuring compliance with existing regulations prohibiting motor vehicles on the trail. Community members were informed about the project during an open-house meeting on September 17, 2025.
content.body:
## Project Update - Nov. 4, 2025

The Discovery Trail maintenance project is now complete. These improvements help protect the trail surface, enhance safety, and ensure the trail remains accessible for people walking, biking, and using mobility devices. We appreciate your understanding and hope you enjoy the refreshed trail!

### Project update - Sept. 9, 2025

In response to community feedback, the City moved back the start date of the trail maintenance project to the week of October 13.

We hoped this allowed everyone enough time to move any RVs, boats or trailers that require trail access.

### Informational meeting

On Sept. 17, the City provided the opportunity for community members to talk with City staff to discuss details of the project. This was an open-house meeting, meaning attendees could come by anytime during the hour that City staff was there.

**On-Site Informational Meeting Details:**

- Wednesday, Sept. 17 from 5 to 6 p.m.
- On-site at the trail, [approximately halfway between 84th Ave. and 86th Ave.](https://maps.app.goo.gl/A9AVNgjg28JTyNsm9) (where the trail has a connection west to Ingalls Cir.)
- City staff were available throughout the hour-long meeting time to answer questions about the project

## Project overview

The City of Arvada has invested $50,000 in necessary concrete maintenance to a north-south segment of the Discovery Trail between 84th Ave. and 86th Ave.

As part of the maintenance project, new fencing was installed at each end of the segment that limits trail access to pedestrians and non-motorized traffic only.

The trail will remain open for people walking, biking, and using mobility devices.

**As a reminder, motor vehicles are not allowed on City trails.**

## What’s changed

Fences have been added at the following locations:

- Intersection of Gray Ct. and W. 84th Ave. (just north of Parr Elementary School) on the south end of the trail segment
- The north end of the trail segment at W. 86th Ave.

**No motor vehicles (cars, trucks, trailers, RVs, boats on trailers, etc.) will be able to access the trail or open space behind homes.**

### Map of a north-south segment of the Discovery Trail from W. 84th Ave. to W. 84th Ave. with fences

### Why we’re doing this

- Protect the trail with long-term maintenance investment.
- Improve safety for all trail users.
- Enforce existing City rules prohibiting motor vehicles on this trail.

### Questions?

The best and most efficient way to provide feedback and get your questions answered is by using [Ask Arvada.](/898)
